name: HumbleObject
summary: Reduces the part that cannot be tested to a shell thin enough not to need testing, and moves the logic somewhere that can.

roles.name: HumbleObject
roles.summary: The thin remainder — the view, the handler, the job that only a running framework can exercise. What makes it humble is that it holds no decision, and that is precisely the claim to keep true: every line that creeps back into it is a line no test can reach, and nothing else in the code will say so.
